timing_locked: boolean. True only when director supplies actual audio lock
audio_file: absolute local path of full-timeline dry narration (optional for snapshots)
audio_mix_file: optional completed full-timeline mix, preferred over audio_file
last_speech_end_s: global last spoken endpoint; E001.end must equal this +3 exactly once
note: scene times/captions global seconds; anchors/sentence_times local seconds. Optional brand insert slots cover explicit scene gaps. Pass --timing. Any unique scene IDs; each must be present in script, lock and a visual renderer/spec. Extra scenes use extra_scenes.py or --scene-data.
